# anthropic_plugin_marketplace (Resource)

Beta. Manages the default installation setting of an existing organization plugin marketplace (`POST /v1/organizations/plugin_marketplaces/{id}`). Available to Claude Enterprise organizations only.

Marketplaces are created and deleted in claude.ai, so this resource adopts an existing one. Destroy only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the last default in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopts a marketplace created in claude.ai and sets its default installation setting.
resource "anthropic_plugin_marketplace" "library" {
  marketplace_id                  = "marketplace_01EXAMPLE"
  default_installation_preference = "available"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_installation_preference` (String) Installation setting every plugin in the marketplace gets unless it has its own: `required`, `auto_install`, `available` or `not_available`.
- `marketplace_id` (String) ID of an existing organization plugin marketplace (`marketplace_...`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the marketplace was created.
- `id` (String) Same as `marketplace_id`.
- `last_sync_ended_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the most recent synchronization attempt ended. Null when not synchronized.
- `last_sync_read_sha` (String) Commit the last synchronization read. Null when not synchronized.
- `name` (String) Name of the marketplace, fixed for its lifetime.
- `owner_type` (String) Owner of the marketplace, always `organization` for one managed here.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Always null for an organization marketplace.
- `source` (String) Where its plugins come from: `manual` (uploaded), or `github`, `gitlab`, `public_git` (synchronized from a Git repository).
- `sync_status` (String) Outcome of the most recent repository synchronization. Null when never synchronized.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_plugin_marketplace.library marketplace_01EXAMPLE
```
